brief:
An Egyptian-American doctor who conducted medical missions to Gaza has been elected to the U.S. House of Representatives from New Jersey, Middle East Eye reported. Adam Hamawy's victory makes him the first Muslim to represent the state in the chamber.

Hamawy's election comes as he gains prominence for humanitarian work in Gaza, combining his medical background with advocacy efforts in the region.

title: Egyptian doctor elected first Muslim to represent New Jersey in House
